reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Allow JKS/PKCS12 keystore passwords to be set as literal values in Certificate resources, mutually exclusive with the existing `passwordSecretRef` field", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: New optional way to set keystore passwords; existing Certificates that use passwordSecretRef are not described as affected.

proposed.statement: Certificate resources can now set JKS/PKCS12 keystore passwords as literal values, mutually exclusive with the existing passwordSecretRef field; this is an opt-in addition.
